review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (Kotlin & React Preferred)
review_candidates.description: NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group. Job Description As a Senior / Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing and supporting large-scale software systems, taking ownership across the full software development lifecycle from technical design through to production support. What will you do? Software Development & Engineering Design, build and support software products for large-scale and business-critical systems. Translate complex and ambiguous requirements into scalable, resilient and production-ready software solutions. Develop and maintain backend services using Kotlin, with strong focus on performance, reliability and maintainability. Develop full-stack solutions using Kotlin and ReactJS, where applicable. Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL to design and optimise data models and queries. Apply sound software engineering principles and best practices throughout the development lifecycle. System Integration, Deployment & Operations Take ownership of applications from technical design through development, testing, deployment and production support. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and deployment processes. Deploy and operate applications on cloud platforms using containerisation and orchestration technologies. Implement application monitoring, observability and logging to ensure system reliability and performance. Participate in incident response, troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production issues. Identify system bottlenecks and drive improvements to application performance, reliability and operational efficiency. Technical Design & Continuous Improvement Evaluate technical solutions and make practical, data-driven recommendations for complex engineering problems. Identify opportunities to improve systems, development tooling and engineering practices. Drive technical improvements from proposal through to implementation and completion. Ensure solutions adhere to appropriate security, scalability, reliability and maintainability standards. Stakeholder Collaboration Collaborate with cross-functional teams and non-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions. Communicate technical proposals and recommendations clearly, using data and sound engineering judgement. Work effectively with team members to promote knowledge sharing, continuous learning and engineering best practices. Qualifications The ideal candidate should possess: Around 5 years or more of relevant experience in software engineering, preferably in complex, large-scale systems or projects. Strong software engineering fundamentals across the full development lifecycle, including software development, testing, CI/CD, deployment, observability and security. Strong experience with Kotlin and relational databases such as PostgreSQL. Experience with ReactJS and full-stack development would be advantageous. Experience deploying and operating applications on cloud platforms. Hands-on experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies. Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, scalability, reliability and performance optimisation. Demonstrated experience supporting applications in production, including troubleshooting and incident response. Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to take technical decisions from design through to production support. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through complex and ambiguous technical problems. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive mindset with a strong commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing and process improvement. Ability to challenge assumptions constructively and propose practical, well-reasoned technical solutions. Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline. We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity —and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future . Together, we make the extraordinary happen . Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site. review_candidates.title: ADAS Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【岗位职责】 Develop, enhance and maintain existing developed ADAS algorithms such as AEB, ACC, LKA, Lane Centering and Vehicle Motion Control. Integration of third-party IP algorithms in QNX. Collaborate closely with India-based engineering teams to take end-to-end ownership of ADAS software components. Act as a technical bridge between China-based Tier-1 supplier and TMPV engineering team in India to ensure alignment and effective communication. Work cross-functionally with system engineering, software integration, and validation teams to ensure seamless system integration. Participate in real-world vehicle testing and validation activities in China. Analyse vehicle data and debug system behaviour. Support issue analysis, root cause identification, and resolution during development and validation phases. 【任职要求】 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Embedded Systems, or a related field. Minimum 10 years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on ADAS algorithm development. Hands-on experience with high performance SoCs (NVIDIA or Qualcomm). Strong programming skills in C++ or Model-Based Development (Matlab/Simulink). Hands-on experience in developing ADAS components such as Vehicle Motion Control, Sensor Fusion, ADAS Applications (AEB, ACC, LKA, Lane Centring). Good understanding of vehicle dynamics, automotive control systems (PID, MPC), Kalman Filters / State Estimation techniques. Hands-on experience in integration of ADAS software components in QNX Operating System. Good understanding of AUTOSAR (Classic and/or Adaptive). Experience with debugging and analysis tools such as CANoe. Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet, SOME/IP). Good proficiency in both English and Chinese (spoken and written) to enable effective communication between India and China teams.
